Storage estimate 100,000/day × 30 × 400 bytes = 1.2 GB decimal; 10 active runs at 10 s gives 1 run/s. Independently checked RLS, SCIM and Stripe meter timing at the recorded source scope. Frontier product self-description was inherited from the package evidence and was not independently reopened in this review. AI sample totals 3/6 strict success with 1/2 protected-access violations, as documented. Adversarial helper checks: `Ledger.record(... eligible=2)` is accepted and multiplies billable units by 2 (400 cost produces 800 billable); `eligible=-1` can produce negative billable usage. `Quota` also permits reserve→settle(run,400)→reserve(same run,800)→settle(run,800), totaling 1,200 for the same run. These reveal gaps in the teaching helpers’ input-domain/idempotency coverage. The quota model is explicitly serial/capacity-only and the package’s run lifecycle is separately specified, so this is treated as a check-helper gap rather than a claim that a real deployment allows duplicate runs.
